title: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi chỗ nào yên tĩnh hơn được không?
pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi cho nao yen tinh hon duoc khong
summary: For asking staff to move to a quieter table or waiting spot.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask while pointing gently toward another table, corner, or area away from music or street noise.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep your tone calm; the request is about hearing each other, not complaining.

phrases.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi chỗ nào yên tĩnh hơn được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi cho nao yen tinh hon duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Chúng tôi có thể asks can we; ngồi means sit; chỗ nào yên tĩnh hơn means somewhere quieter; được không? asks if possible.

breakdown.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi chỗ nào yên tĩnh hơn được không?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Inside, outside, and fan-seat phrases cover nearby seating choices.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at cafes, restaurants, lounges, waiting rooms, and hotel breakfast areas.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If staff cannot move you, they may point to a waiting area or quieter time.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Table request, wait time, fan seat, cooler seat, and clean table phrases cover the seating conversation around it.
